correctness.rationale: From stationary characteristic equation (r+Dk²)φ(k)=rφ(ak), the product of independent Laplace factors yields Yq=√Vq Z with Vq=(1−q)Σ q^j Ej and q=a²; mean Vq=1, Var(Vq)=(1−q)/(1+q). For q1<q2, ordered geometric weights have every prefix 1−q^k greater, hence finite Schur-convexity and controlled truncation imply Vq2≤cx Vq1; independent multiplication by Z² preserves convex order. Direct Gaussian/Laplace normal and exponential integration gives the sharp endpoint stop-loss curves; positive-threshold strictness follows conditional Jensen. Uniform Taylor on t in positive compact sets with bounded third derivative, exact fourth-centered moment O((1−q)²), gives first correction t^{3/2}φ(√t)(1−q)/[2(1+q)] and O((1−q)^{3/2}). The Gaussian q↑1 endpoint is limiting only; t=0 has equal risk. Checked four kurtosis identities independently.
